skill_name: Describe how a computer and a smartphone are different.
workflow: Computers (desktop and laptop) and smartphones are both computers, but they differ in several ways. Computers tend to be larger and bulkier and require regular maintenance. They also require more power than a smartphone and typically have more energy-consuming components such as multiple fans and larger processors.
